1.
Public hearing to consider four separate appeals of the Planning Commission's approval of a Major Use Permit, Design Review Permit, Parcel Map Waiver and Coastal Development Permit to consolidate four existing lots into one lot and to allow the construction and operation of a K-8 private school with a maximum capacity of 270 students throughout eight new buildings. The eight buildings total 31,105 square feet. The project also includes a temporary construction trailer, site improvements including best management practices, fencing, walls, parking with pervious pavers and landscaping. CASE NUMBER: MULTI-002885-2016, SUB-002897-2016, USE-002898-2016, DR-002896-2016 & CDPNF-002916-2016 (16-165 MUP/DR/PMW/CDP); APPLICANT: Waldorf in North Coastal, Inc.; APPELLANT #1: Manolo Turner; APPELLANT #2: Carmen Nespor; APPELLANT #3: Glen Johnson; APPELLANT #4: Steven Gerken; LOCATION: 749 Mays Hollow Lane (APNs: 257-020-28, -29, -30 & -31). Contact Person: Principal Planner Colamussi
Deny the appeals and adopt Resolution No. 2020-50 affirming the decisions of the Planning Commission.

2.
Storm Drain Construction Contracts associated with 1691 and 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Council to authorize the City Manager in consultation with the City Attorney to implement either Action A or B.
ACTION A: If by July 20, 2020 (21 Days), the City receives an executed drainage easement from the owners (Cummins) of 1691 Eolus Avenue, the City shall:
a) Prepare bid documents and advertise:
1) the lining of approximately 70 feet of existing 24-inch storm drain pipe crossing 1691 Eolus Avenue and approximately 90 of existing storm drain pipe crossing 1711 Eolus Avenue;
2) replacing an existing catch basin on the west side of Eolus Avenue and;
3) replacing an existing 12-inch storm drain pipe with a 24-inch storm drain line.
b) Terminate the existing construction contract with Growth Development Marketing Inc. executed on January 19, 2020 for $81,180 and resolve any remaining contract issues.
ACTION B: If by July 20, 2020, the City does not receive an executed drainage easement from the owners (Cummins) of 1691 Eolus Avenue, the City shall:
a) Execute Construction Change Order No. 1 in substantial form as shown in Attachment 2 and any necessary amendments and time extensions with Growth Development Marketing, Inc. (GDM, Inc.) in the amount of $69,678 to modify the installation technique for a portion of storm drain line on the 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain project. The current contract cost is $81,180, if approved, the new construction contract cost will be $150,858.
b) Authorize an additional $10,452 to provide fifteen percent contingency on the new construction contract cost of $150,858. If approved, the total not-to-exceed amount authorized by City Council for the GDM Inc. contract and this change order would be $173,487.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
